definitions.gallery: All test images of the queried category, including good images and other defects.
definitions.relevant: Test images whose defect-folder name equals the query.
definitions.recall@k: Fraction of relevant images that fall in the top k.
definitions.hit@k: 1 if the top k contains at least one relevant image.
definitions.mAP: Mean average precision. macro_* averages categories equally; micro_mAP averages queries equally.
definitions.figure: For each figure category, the query with the median AP. Not the best query.
